notes: v470 — the brain starts moving to the server. Your signals can now be scored on our Cloudflare worker instead of inside the app, which is what stops anyone reading the exact thresholds out of the published file. This release is the app half: it asks the server first, and if the server is old, busy, wrong or unreachable it quietly falls back to scoring on your device — so nothing breaks before or after the worker is updated. The two engines were checked against each other over 120 shares and 300 days, 32,196 signal fires, with zero differences, so the numbers are identical either way. The Evidence line now says which one answered. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
